why-race-to-backwardness-is-india-s-bigg.title: Why race to backwardness is India's biggest nightmare?
why-race-to-backwardness-is-india-s-bigg.description: Being more weak in India is a super power. The weaker you show yourself, the more the government will try to empower you.
why-race-to-backwardness-is-india-s-bigg.content: When I see the race to be more Backward in India, I think of what Swami Vivekananda ji said: "The weak have no place here, in this life or any other life. Weakness leads to slavery. Weakness leads to all kinds of misery, physical and mental. Weakness is death." There is nothing that is worse than "weakness", however today, being more weak in India is a super power. The weaker you show yourself, the more the government will try to empower you. The stronger you are, the more your government will try to undermine you, disrespect you and you will be hated by weaker communities. Look at the Brahmins They are considered to be thought leader, fairly well economically, and are at the top of the varnas. Yet we see slogans like "Bhraminwad Murdabad", Bhramin women are openly abused by many of these so called Dalit and OBC leader, and the Modi government doesn't say a word. These were the same OBC and Dalit leader who were abusing the Muslims 5-7 years ago. Booking Ajeet Bharti under the Modi Act, is just one example. Who is not against the Brahmins today? Leftists, Bhim Army, CJP guys, to some extent AAP, Congress, SP, LJP, RJD; is there anyone left? Is there any political party left for the Brahmins other than the BJP, where they can be sidelined and slapped Bi-Weekly? Shekhar Gupta has correctly said: Brahmins' vote is the same for the BJP, that the Muslims' vote is for the Congress. So, the lines of Swami Vivekananda ji, prove to be wrong here. Because in India, the weaker you are economically and socially, the stronger you become politically. Under the Modi-Shah BJP, the weak have a place in India; and it's on the 50% of reserved seats in Government jobs and Educational institutions, and it comes with the right to abuse the Upper Caste Hindu's and the Muslims pari passu. ___ Find me on LinkedIn & Twitter.
